## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at HMS Belfast, The Queen's Walk, London SE1 2JH, Великобритания.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step aboard HMS Belfast, an iconic symbol of Britain’s naval history, moored on the River Thames in London. This World War II-era warship, now a museum, offers a fascinating journey through time, immersing you in the stories of bravery and maritime innovation that shaped the nation’s past.
>
> Explore the decks, from the commanding officer’s bridge to the engine rooms below. With nine decks to discover, you’ll experience life aboard ship, including the gun turrets, restored cabins, and mess rooms where sailors dined and socialized.
>
> Engaging exhibits bring HMS Belfast’s history to life, from its role in the Arctic Convoys to the D-Day landings. Audio guides and interactive displays enhance your visit, offering a deeper understanding of this remarkable ship’s legacy.
>
> Take a moment to step outside and enjoy stunning views of London, with landmarks like Tower Bridge and the Shard in the background.
>
> HMS Belfast is not just a museum—it’s a journey through history. Plan your visit today and discover this enduring symbol of Britain’s naval heritage.
